name: Hojai

queries.query: Hojai Assam cadastral parcel map GIS official land records map
queries.result: Located official Hojai District land-revenue documentation, Assam ILRMS/Dharitree, and the Assam Bhunaksha parcel viewer. The Hojai District page documents land-holding trace maps and ILRMS; Bhunaksha exposes parcel geometry through its public viewer backend.

queries.query: হোজাই অসম ভূমি মানচিত্ৰ দাগ নক্সা চৰকাৰী GIS
queries.result: Located the official Assam ILRMS/Dharitree service listing Hojai (হোজাই), and the official Bhunaksha viewer. The Assamese-language search did not by itself establish a separate local municipal service; the verified parcel route is the Assam state service bounded to Hojai Town No. 1.

registryBasis: The official Assam Bhunaksha viewer returned parcel geometries for Hojai district, Hojai circle, Hojai Town No. 1 using a public backend route. The Hojai District government page independently documents ILRMS land records and land-holding trace maps.

officialSources.observation: Official NIC Assam Bhunaksha viewer; shipped JavaScript points to the public bhunakshaBackEnd service and identifies parcel, location-code, dag-number, and CRS handling.
Official Hojai District page says Assam ILRMS handles land records and lists land-holding trace maps as a citizen service.
Official Assam Dharitree selection page lists Hojai district and the district/circle/village-town hierarchy.

requests.outcome: Viewer HTML fetched; current JavaScript asset identified as /assets/index-qVUqnX9k.js.
Current first-party JavaScript inspected. It revealed backend routes for districts, circles, villages, getAllDagsFromDharitree, and parcel_info; it also revealed parcel CRS handling as EPSG:32646.
Returned Assam districts; Hojai was identified as district code 36.
Returned Hojai, Lanka, and Dabaka circles; Hojai circle code 360109 selected.
Returned 101 villages/towns; Hojai Town No. 1 code 360109010520001, Hojai Town No. 2 code 360109010520002, and Hojai Town No. 3 code 360109010520003 were identified.
Returned the Hojai Town No. 1 dag catalogue. Only the dag numbers needed for the bounded three-feature sample were followed up.
Three HTTP 200 parcel responses returned MultiPolygon geometries and native stable uniqueId values. Raw responses are retained only in ignored scratch under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/11993/.

source.name: Assam Bhunaksha parcel viewer/backend
source.operator: National Informatics Centre, Assam / Government of Assam
source.responseFormat: JSON containing parcel records with geometry text and native identifiers
source.nativeIdentity: uniqueId, observed in the parcel_info response; locationCode and dag_no retained as provenance metadata only

fieldMapping.geom: GeoJSON geometry after EPSG:32646 to EPSG:4326 conversion

source.scope: Verified only for three parcels in Hojai Town No. 1, Hojai circle, Hojai district. Wider Hojai town/district coverage, update cadence, and service stability remain unverified.

verifiedParcelResponse.queryPointUse: WUP locator only; no coordinate shift or exact-point hit claim

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Assam state parcel viewer with Hojai district land-record integration.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three public parcel geometries in Hojai Town No. 1 only; no citywide completeness claim.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point lies away from the sampled Hojai Town No. 1 polygons; that is not an absence finding. The sample does not establish coverage for Hojai Town Nos. 2 or 3, the full municipality, or the district. Raw response attributes included unsafe owner/deed-related fields and were not retained or queried for use.
